Clause-②: no

Original text: the three commits by the first epic seat (`session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU`), carried from #34675's branch `claude/sharp-cray-3nr8u9` and rebased onto `main` unchanged. This PR adds one commit that brings the record to the rulings. It decides nothing new.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：把 MCP 本地优先设计文档从「等待裁决的草稿」改成「已裁决的设计记录」：状态行、裁决节、E2 候选、里程碑表全部对齐已记录的裁决。
- **为什么改**：原稿写于裁决之前，仍写着 D1–D7、E1–E4 待定，E2 还是旧的写法；里程碑一已放行，文档需要和 #34659 正文一致才能落地。
- **风险与回滚**：只有一个文档文件，不进任何发布包；回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**：`docs/design/mcp-local-first-door.md` 的「Decisions (ruled)」节与 Design C 第 5 条（E2 的写法：候选永不算命中，契约归 #34761 / #34763）。
- **两分钟验证**：打开该文件的「Milestones」节，对照 #34659 正文的里程碑表，卡号应一一对应。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One file, `docs/design/mcp-local-first-door.md` (+53 / -39 in this PR's own commit; +168 against `main` with the original three commits).

- The status line names each ruling record and its date instead of "nothing adopted".
- "Decisions asked of the maintainer" becomes "Decisions (ruled)", quoting the maintainer only verbatim, from the records.
- E2 is written as re-ruled by F1 B. The record says candidates never count as a match and points to #34761 / #34763 for the contract; it no longer states a matcher of its own.
- The milestone section follows #34659's body, card by card. M-0 stays as history.
- Every objectstack file:line was re-read on `6091b645`; moved ones were corrected. Cloud readings were not re-taken: they are labelled with their reading commit and listed under Not verified.
- Each Current state row names the card that carries it. None of those cards has merged, so no row claims a fix.

## Tests

Docs only: no package, test or gate code changed, so there are no unit tests to run and no ablation applies.

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` reports a conflict with #34675 on this same file. That is the supersession, not a collision: #34675 stays open as a draft until this lands.
- Changeset: `docs/design/**` ships in no package's `files[]`, so this PR carries `skip-changeset` and no changeset.
- The original commits keep their author's trailers; this PR's commit carries the model-free pair.

## Verification

Head `a986e35d`.

Tier: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --tier docs/design/mcp-local-first-door.md` exit 0, "Model tier — no path-derived mandate: the surface hits none of the 4 declared glob(s)". No mandate is named, so this body carries no Served-tier line.

<details><summary>Local derived gates: 16 derived, 16 run, every exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 16 commands against merge base `6091b645`. All exited 0:

- `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs` and `--self-test`
- `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` and `--self-test`
- `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` (22653 files, 0 disagree)
- `node scripts/ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs --self-test`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`. The first run exited 3, a prerequisite refusal (lint and formula not built), so it measured nothing. After `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0), the re-run exited 0.
- `pnpm check:adr-anchors`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:watch-hint-literal`

`dispatch-gates --ran` with every command and its exit code: "16 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 16 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". A control-byte self-scan of the file found nothing.

CI runs everything else (artifact rosters, wide-population families, type-check lanes).

</details>

<details><summary>Re-measurement of every objectstack file:line, on 6091b645</summary>

- No hit for `restriction-profile` outside `packages/cli` and `packages/spec`, so no runtime serves the route. `meta register` has no mode flag, and `lint` has no item flag. `packages/lint/src` has no non-test hit for `NO_EXECUTOR` and no approve/reject edge check.
- 9 scenario cards, 0 of them mention a dataset or a synonym. No `skills/**` file names `list_datasets`.
- Card states, read today: #34685, #34686, #34687, #34689, #34718, #34720, #34721, #34761, #34763, #34764, #34787 are open; #34790 is an open draft. None has merged.
